fields.name: CIVILIAN Survey
fields.description:
You are invited to participate in a research survey to understand how residents perceive their neighbourhood. As a resident, there is no better person than you to indicate and describe the positive and negative aspects of your neighbourhood. You are the expert, and your answers are very valuable to us in understanding what residents find important to make a neighbourhood a nice place to live.

In the survey, you will be asked questions about the neighbourhood where you live, places you like or dislike, places to be improved, and places where you identify an issue (such as noise or pollution). No personal data will be collected or published.
As researchers, we aim to collect and analyse your data and make recommendations for decision-makers. We will also make your voices heard by making your answers public on a dashboard that is available to all.

The survey is completely anonymous. Your participation in this study is entirely voluntary, and you can withdraw at any time. You are free to skip questions. Since it is anonymous, removing data once the form is completed is not possible. As with any online activity, the risk of a breach is always possible, but to the best of our ability, your answers will remain confidential.

This study is part of the Citizen Voice initiative at the Delft University of Technology. In case you have questions or would like to be updated on the outcomes of this study, you can contact Juliana Goncalves (Assistant Professor in the Department of Urbanism, TU Delft) J.E.Goncalves@tudelft.nl.

By proceeding with the survey, you agree to this Opening Statement and provide informed consent to participate.

fields.name: Questions Types
fields.description: This demo showcase the types of questions available in the app.

fields.name: Quick Demo Map
fields.description: Source: Esri, i-cubed, USDA, USGS, AEX, GeoEye, Getmapping, Aerogrid, IGN, IGP, UPR-EGP, and the GIS User Community

fields.text: Please select the statement that represents your feelings about the neighbourhood where you currently live.
fields.choices:
I like to live in my neighbourhood and intend to stay here for many years., 
I like to live in my neighbourhood but would like to move elsewhere in the city., 
I do not like to live in my neighbourhood and I would like to move elsewhere in the city.,
I do not like to live in my neighbourhood but would like to see it improve.,
I like to live in my neighbourhood but I am living here temporarily and plan to move to another city.,
Other.

fields.text: What is your favourite area in the neighbourhood and why?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map.

fields.text: What is your least favourite area in the neighbourhood and why?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map.

fields.text: What is the closest green area to your house?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map.

fields.text: In your neighbourhood, where would you like to see more green areas, and what kind of green would you like to see there (flowers, trees, vegetables)?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map, and click on the symbol to type the kind of green you would like.

fields.text: In your neighbourhood, where do you often see wild animals, and what animals did you see (for example, birds, butterflies, bees, frogs, fishes, squirrels, rabbits, and other small animals)?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map, and click on the symbol to type what have you seen.

fields.text: In your neighbourhood, what public places, like parks, sidewalks, and squares, do you think could be improved and how?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map, and click on the symbol to type how they can be improved.

fields.text: Could you identify the places in your neighbourhood where air pollution is a problem and describe where the pollution comes from?
fields.explanation: Please mark these on the map.

fields.text: Could you identify the places in your neighbourhood where noise is a problem and describe where the noise comes from?
fields.explanation: Please mark these on the map.

fields.text: Could you identify the places in your neighbourhood where you feel unsafe?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map.

fields.text: In your neighbourhood, where do you feel the hottest during summer days and heat waves?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map.

fields.text: In your neighbourhood, where do you see water on the ground after a heavy rain?
fields.explanation: Please mark it on the map.

fields.text: Could you identify the places in your neighbourhood where waste/trash is a problem?
fields.explanation: Please mark these on the map.

fields.text: Is there anything else you would like to say about your neighbourhood?
Long text question
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered with multiple lines of text. Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must fill the text field if set to 'required'

fields.text: Short text question
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered with a single line of text. Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must fill the text field if set to 'required'

fields.text: Single choice question
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered by choosing one of the choices. Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must give an answer if set to 'required'

fields.text: Multiple choice question
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered by choosing one  or more of the options. Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must give an answer if set to 'required'

fields.text: Number question: Integer
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered by entering a quantity (number without decimals). Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must give an answer if set to 'required'

fields.text: Date question
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered by providing a date. Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must give an answer if set to 'required'

fields.text: Upload image question
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered by uploading an image. Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must upload an image if set to 'required'

fields.text: Likert scale question
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered by rating a topic. Scales can be customised.  Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must give an answer if set to 'required'

fields.text: Geo-Spatial Question
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered by drawing on a map. Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must give draw at list one item if set to 'required'

fields.text: Where do you live?
fields.explanation: Geo-spatial questions present a map were respondents can draw on, and add descriptions to each item. Optionally, they also can have a text field to add details to enrich or explain their answers.

fields.text: Geo-spatial question with text
fields.explanation: Geo-spatial question can have long or short text fields for additional details. Maps can show different information (below a gray colored map by CartoDB)

fields.text: Number question: Float
fields.explanation: A question that can be answered by entering a quantity (number with decimals). Questions can be set to 'required' or 'optional'. Respondents must give an answer if set to 'required'
